channel.title: Pawstcard Journal
channel.description: Practical notes for independent pet sitters and dog walkers: client updates, visit report cards, and running a solo pet-care business.

item.title: Pet Sitter Photo Updates: How Many to Send and What to Shoot
item.description: How many photos to send per visit, which three shots matter, and how to take them quickly without letting your phone take over the visit.

item.title: How to Write a Pet Sitting Visit Report Clients Actually Read
item.description: A simple five-part structure for pet sitting visit reports, with a checklist, a sample note, and the mistakes that make clients stop reading.
